context.transcript:
This museum offers free admission on Wednesday nights, doesn't it?
A. Mostly abstract paintings and sculptures.
B. She accepted the job offer.
C. Well, a donation is appreciated.
context.transcript_translation:
这家博物馆周三晚上提供免费入场，对吗？
A. 主要展示抽象画和雕塑。
B. 她接受了这份工作邀请。
C. 嗯，捐款是受欢迎的。
